subject: How to remove dependent events when using my own manually created recordTableSample?

messages.subject: How to remove dependent events when using my own manually created recordTableSample?
parts:
Hi there!

Because I am working with video instead of image data, I have had to manually create my own version of recordTableSample.
I have run into the problem of figuring out how to remove dependent events (minDeltaTime = 60) because that is taken care of in the function recordTable which I cannot use.

Might there be another way to remove dependent events?

Thank you, I appreciate any advice you can offer me!

Cheers,

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: How to remove dependent events when using my own manually created recordTableSample?
parts:
Hi Meryl,
currently there is no built-in function to do this for you. It may be a helpful feature though for future releases of the package. Thank you for the suggestion.
Here is some code you can use in the meantime:

# try this with the sample record table
data(recordTableSample)

# split it into separate data frames for each station/species combination
recs_split <- split(x = recordTableSample,
                    f = list(recordTableSample$Station,
                             recordTableSample$Species),
                    drop = TRUE)

# calculate time intervals between subsequent records within these data frames and save as new column "difftime"
rec.df.list <- lapply(recs_split, FUN = function(x){
  x <- x[order(x$DateTimeOriginal),]
  difftime_tmp <- diff(x$DateTimeOriginal)
  units(difftime_tmp) <- "secs"
  x$difftime <- c(NA, difftime_tmp)
  return(x)
  }
  )

# reassemble into 1 data frame
recordTableSample2 <- do.call("rbind", rec.df.list)

# remove records within 60 minutes of one another (3600 seconds or NA if it was the first record of a species at a station)
recordTableSample2a <- recordTableSample2[recordTableSample2$difftime >= 3600 |
                                          is.na(recordTableSample2$difftime),]

Best regards,
Jürgen

Please note there was a problem in the code above which is fixed now. 
In the calculation of difftime, the first record of a species at a station had difftime = NA and was thus also removed from the subset of the record table (recordTableSample2a).
It is fixed now.
